meta.title: KERI Value System
meta.notes: Generated from the published Google Sheet by scripts/fetch-data.mjs. Nodes come from the Nodes tab; links come from the Vertices tab (Source, Destination, Connection Context, Personas). Node weight is derived from the number of connections (3-9); link weight defaults to 1. Weights are subjective and adjustable in the edit panel.

nodes.label: PERPETUAL
nodes.description: persistent identity, crypto period, pre-rotation, hashed-not-signed, duplicity detection, self-associate data, reputation

nodes.label: ENTROPY
nodes.description: unbreakable, only bruteforceable, sufficient randomness, uncorrelatable, bulk issuances

nodes.label: SECUFIRST
nodes.description: Security first in the protocol and the system, because you will have nothing if it breaks. Fortify upfront (uncorrelatability), no intermediate infrastructure vulnerabilities, extra security mechanisms where relevant, like decentralization and bulk issuances.

nodes.label: SAFETY
nodes.description: Security first, always, for humans and things, built for fault tolerance and proven context. Accountability so that you have recourse against your peers. Non-repudiation, end-to-end verifiability, verifiable to the root of trust, sign everything, no cross-context correlation. Many eyes make bugs shallow. When in doubt, rotate out.

nodes.label: RECOUPEERS
nodes.description: Recourse on peers: accountability, no exploitation, profiling errors.  You stay in control over peers with profit-seeking motives. Data errors hurt individuals; dangerous, well-meaning bureaucrats associate data without consent. Data can be weaponized against you.

nodes.label: NOSHARSECR
nodes.description: Shared Secrets and you're done (by AI), no middlemen needed, no shared governance (blockchain)

nodes.label: MINIMSUFFI
nodes.description: Minimally sufficient (all others will converge to KERI), no partial KERI possible, no "KERI Light", single source of truth.

nodes.label: FAULTTOL
nodes.description: Fault tolerant because you anticipate breaches, theft, errors, etc and you recover from these events, cascade consequences (automatically revoke authorization), no single point of failure

nodes.label: UNBROCHAIN
nodes.description: Unbroken chain of events (2 root of trust, hash tree, blockchain), git and github versioning, actions, versioning and backward compatibility, etc.

nodes.label: ATSCALE
nodes.description: Able to service global scale, omnipresent, any time, anyone, anywhere, versatility, interoperability by design, (be able to) scale up.

nodes.label: GRALIFCONF
nodes.description: Gradual lifting of confidentiality, gradual disclosure depending on counterpart role, contextual display, selective disclosure.

nodes.label: AGNOSTIC
nodes.description: Agnostic; cryptography agnostic, wallet agnostic, intermediate infrastructure agnostic, no vendor lock, versatility

nodes.label: LEGOVPOL
nodes.description: Implementation/infrastructure for Legal (laws, regulations) governance, policies, (readable) Ricardian contracts

nodes.label: SPACTRILL
nodes.description: Spac trillema: Security first always. Gradual lifting of confidentiality. No privacy without accountability, delegated guardian relationships, cooperative, balanced through multi-sig authorizations

nodes.label: ORGID
nodes.description: Organizational Identity and root of trust, first person control and safety, accountability of - and recourse on officers, records of decisions attributable and its context proven, transfer credential sets, legal mandates and obligations, delegation of tasks and responsibilities, you can't have all perks at the same time, verifiable commitments to data,

nodes.label: HARPROB1ST
nodes.description: Solved hard problem first, got rid of complexity, decentralized trust, persistent identifiers, delegable key management, solved problems others can't solve, got rid of username-passwords, truly portable identifiers, made it scalable and faulttolerant at all times

nodes.label: REALMPRAGM
nodes.description: Realism pragmatism: Correlation always on the web, no privacy on the web. Accountable, not trying to constrain; no hiding but 'no exploitation'; simplicity, clarity, availability of tooling, reduce troubles and keep it simple.

nodes.label: CANMODELRW
nodes.description: Can model real-world (authority) structures; all others can't! Asynchronous operation online/offline , sustain reputation

nodes.label: OTHUNSAFE
nodes.description: Other systems are unsafe or insecure, leaking data, being ephemeral, producing false positives, false-negative profiling, etc.

nodes.label: VERCOMTMT
nodes.description: Verifiable Commitments to data, long-term verifiability, non-repudiability, in a cryptographically proven context, wrap and enrich other data formats, verifiable data graph

nodes.label: ANTIFRAUD
nodes.description: The main stickiness factor that's compelling and contagious. Safety is pivotal, but we can't extinguish fraud. Therefore, we need fault tolerance and recourse against bad actors. Because of its decentralized nature, even AI-driven attacks won't pay off. Other systems can't offer this value; they have known flaws that attackers will exploit.

nodes.label: 1PERSCONTR
nodes.description: First-person control embedded in legal structures, self-sovereign identity, no usernames and passwords, create personas, consent through transparency, no phone home; who's the better advocate for you than you? Stop multiple fees for doccing, updating, forwarding, extracting, aggregating data. Not taken hostage by multiple-linked accounts of one company.

nodes.label: ECONINFEA
nodes.description: Economically Infeasible (to attack), decentralized enough, compensate current interests (data harvesters and aggregators)

nodes.label: NOUSEKERI
nodes.description: “Don’t use KERSuite for these things: ”, It's all of KERI or no KERI. KERI makes no sense without Legal embedding, governance structure and policies.

nodes.label: INCLUSIVE
nodes.description: All encompassing, spanning protocol, accessible for all people, most universal, open-source, adhere to open standards, free, if it wasn't open source, we would not consider it. comprehensive utility

nodes.label: VERNOTVAL
nodes.description: Verify not validate, zero-trust environments, sign everything to be verified, hash data and credentials in verifiable containers, proof and prove. Litigious contentions in nobody's land: how to trust the other side of the ecosystem. Less susceptible to fraud.

nodes.label: INCENCOOP
nodes.description: Incentivize cooperation in governance structure, tokonomics, in competition and making money, open and no vendor-lock

nodes.label: PROVCONTXT
nodes.description: Provide and lock in context of the process in a versioned event chain, establish organizational binding and content, schemas, manage personal data/attributes, provably deterministic (no hanging processes/deadlocks)

nodes.label: NOWSTACK
nodes.description: Stack features. “now we can …”, "combinations of the above", etc

nodes.label: EASEOFUSE
nodes.description: interoperability, meet customers where they are, reduce complication, be able to model your solution, hyper churn your credentials, readible streaming formats

nodes.label: BIZEFFCASE
nodes.description: Business and/or efficiency case: Profit, cost reduction, risk reduction, margin higher, but also efficiency: endorsement lifts onboarding and research costs, handling fees to be paid to controllers of your data, single source of truth

nodes.label: INFRASURF
nodes.description: Surf existing infrastructure (OOBIs via X.509, VVP on JWT in Telco, etc), existing laws and regulations, existing programming logic (like structured concurrency in HIO), existing economic models (SEDI), automate manual processes, KERI and ACDC wrappers around existing transactions in existing systems.

nodes.label: MARKETPEN
nodes.description: Market penetration, trust in the protocol, acceptance, interoperability with other protocols, bridge to legacy systems, flooding capacity: seeing is believing, compelling and contagious, universally present and inclusive

nodes.label: GRASPEASY
nodes.description: Easy to explain protocols and tools, simple, clear, as opposed to complicated, not-ingrained concepts, platypus, elephant and blind men

nodes.label: MATURITY
nodes.description: Weathered, complete, thoroughly tested, established in the market, everywhere under the hood, higher-level coding and APIs

nodes.label: COMMUNEDU
nodes.description: Community education of managing secrets, privacy non-existing, selective disclosure, self-association, now being able to stack, (history of) provenance, security breach breaks all, etc.
